- Develop and implement scalable frameworks adopted across the network

- Build and maintain senior stakeholder relationships (up to VP)

- Own key performance metrics including Change Throughput Efficiency Index (CTEI), Change Value Impact Ratio (CVIR), and Dwell Time

- Mentor team members and develop future organizational talent

Key job responsibilities

- Lead complex, multi-site change initiatives end-to-end—from intake through closure—across the global data center network

- Develop comprehensive strategies that measure operational impact and drive continuous improvement

- Architect new methodologies that enhance change management success and achieve org-wide adoption

- Create scalable frameworks for benefit tracking, knowledge capture, and governance that balance rigor with efficiency

- Manage strategic initiatives and organizational transformation programs simultaneously

Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for complex change management issues across the organization

- Drive process improvements and operational excellence best practices, eliminating systemic bottlenecks

- Develop comprehensive white papers, 6-page narratives, and strategic documents (MBR/QBR/HBR/YBR, COEs, PR/FAQs)

- Present validation outcomes and frameworks to senior leadership (up to 3 tiers above level)

- Make independent decisions on strategic network-wide change approaches, complex classification frameworks, and cross-organizational process improvements

A day in the life

As a Senior TPM on the OCM team, no two days look the same—but every day matters. You might start your morning reviewing change requests in the intake queue, assessing complexity and risk to prioritize what moves forward. By mid-morning, you're leading a cross-functional alignment session with engineering, operations, and support teams to plan a network-wide tooling change that will touch multiple data center sites.

About the team

Operations Change Management (OCM) is a critical function within Global Data Center Operations (GDCO) that enables safe, efficient, and value-driven changes for operations, engineering, and other support teams across AWS's global data center network.

Our mission is to ensure that every change—whether a tooling update, process improvement, or infrastructure modification—is managed with rigor, transparency, and a relentless focus on operational excellence. We operate across a structured seven-phase change management framework (Intake, Planning, Approval, Scheduling, Implementation, Validation, and Closure) that balances speed with safety.

Our team culture is built on ownership, innovation, and collaboration. We don't just manage change—we shape how we learn from it. We value builders who think big, dive deep, and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. 

Whether you're developing a new methodology, presenting to senior leadership, or mentoring the next generation of change leaders, you'll find that OCM is a place where your work has real, measurable impact at global scale.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 3+ years of software development experience

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Description

Amazon is seeking an innovative, high-judgment Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join the Regulation Tech & Assurance (RTA) team within Amazon Privacy (Security). We own Responsible AI (RAI) programs that deliver technical governance solutions ensuring compliance with high-impact, urgent AI regulation across Amazon services worldwide — including the EU AI Act, U.S. state-level AI laws (e.g., Colorado SB 189 ADMT requirements), and emerging international frameworks such as South Korea's AI Basic Act.

The Senior TPM will operate at the intersection of AI regulation, data governance, and technical implementation — translating complex legal obligations into enforceable controls, scalable compliance architectures, and measurable outcomes. You will work across Amazon's decentralized business structure to ensure consistent AI governance that delivers on four pan-Amazon outcomes: Quality, Compliance, Assurance, and Speed. This will require helping to frame, and participating in, high judgment debates and decision making across senior business, technology, legal, and public policy leaders.

Key job responsibilities

1. RAI Controls SME — Own expertise in Amazon's AI governance controls: data lineage, broker registration, source-based exclusions, opt-out enforcement, and data retention. Maintain working knowledge of EU AI Act categories (GPAI, High-Risk AI Systems, Article 50 transparency/watermarking, prohibited practices) and emerging U.S. state AI regulations.

2. End-to-End Technical Design — Lead cross-functional design across infrastructure and business teams to architect compliance solutions. Define how requirements flow from policy → standards → control objectives → automated enforcement, driving toward zero-touch compliance.

3. Implementation & Delivery — Drive execution across Legal, AI Security, Privacy, and engineering teams. Own work-back plans against regulatory effective dates, manage dependencies, track risks/blockers, and ensure demonstrable compliance posture for regulators and auditors.

4. Regulatory Interpretation & Strategy — Participate in high-judgment debates across senior business, technology, legal, and public policy leaders on ambiguous requirements (e.g., HRAIS classification, training data disclosure obligations, deemed provider scope). Translate legal interpretations into implementable technical requirements.

5. Cross-Pillar Governance — Partner across RTA's Security, Privacy, and RAI pillars to drive a unified operating model with consistent policy hierarchy, shared assurance tooling, and holistic compliance reporting.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

 

Job Description:

  • Client is transforming into a customer-centric sustainable mobility company and is looking for motivated and passionate individuals to join our team.
  • The Project Management Office (PMO) is a critical function of the Cross Carline & Project Engineering Team and is responsible for the oversight of common processes and methods used to achieve technical, quality, timing, and cost targets.
  • The PMO Planning Specialist is responsible for supporting the Platform and Project Planning Manager in achieving vehicle program timing objectives, driving process improvements, and ensuring effective project execution.
  • This role will primarily focus on project timing management and coordination activities, while leveraging prior program management experience and institutional knowledge to support special assignments and cross-functional initiatives as needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and coordinate overall program timing activities, ensuring alignment and consistency across project phases and milestones.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules to support successful program execution.
  • Identify timing risks, critical path issues, and recovery opportunities, communicating impacts and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to planning, scheduling, reporting, and PMO processes.
  • Support governance reviews by preparing timing-related metrics, dashboards, and executive-level presentations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to program timing commitments and deliverables.
  • Facilitate PMT meetings, Program Reviews, and timing-focused discussions with key stakeholders.
  • Analyze program performance data and recommend process enhancements to improve efficiency, transparency, and execution.
  • Support special projects and assignments by leveraging previous program knowledge, planning expertise, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Interface regularly with Vehicle Project Teams, Platform & Module Teams, Planning (QCTP) Managers, Chief Vehicle Engineers (CVE), and leadership teams.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of automotive industry experience at an OEM or large Tier 1 supplier in program management, project planning, engineering, finance, quality, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex project schedules and coordinating cross-functional deliverables.
  • Strong analytical and process improvement mindset.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work independently and influence teams across multiple organizational levels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Full vehicle program lifecycle experience.
  • Experience with project timing, launch readiness, or PMO functions.
  • Knowledge of Client Product Development Process (PDP).
  • Lean, Continuous Improvement, or process optimization experience.
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills.
  • Experience creating executive-level dashboards and timing reviews.
  • Ability to quickly learn and utilize proprietary planning and reporting tools

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$68,000.00 - $93,500.00

Location:
Kalispell,MT

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Key Responsibilities

Support specific project and program objectives as  defined in the areas of responsibility, and that necessary preliminary activities (e.g., determination of outcomes, milestones, viability studies, and resource planning, among others) are completed.

Support projects and programs assigned are completed in accordance with predetermined requirements, with specific attention to product/process specifications, project/program costs, resource utilization, and timeliness for completion.

Ensures that all phases of project, program and/or process development are documented and that information required in other functional areas is reported, disseminated, or transferred, as appropriate. Ensures compliance with Company policies regarding Engineering/Lab notebooks, patents, confidentiality and safety.

Undertake study of new technologies, as appropriate. 

Support data collection for materials & financial resources.

Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.

Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities

Business Expertise

Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work

Leadership

No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members

Problem Solving

Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents 

Impact

Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills

Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations

The NSO Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of assigned Non-System Orders (NSOs) from project release through shipment. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Product Team

You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 

The Role

As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 

What Excites You

  • Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

  • Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

  • Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

  • Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

  • Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

  • Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

  • Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

  • AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

  • Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

 

What Excites Us

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

  • You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

  • Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

  • Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

  • AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

  • Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while running it

  • Clinical trials, drug development, or health data experience is a strong plus. Exceptional PMs without it are welcome.

Bonus

  • Former lead or head of product who wants to build hands-on again

  • Experience shipping for expert or scientific users

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

title: Senior Computational Biologist
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines.

What you'll do

  • You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation.

  • Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny.

  • Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data

  • You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous.

You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers.

Must have

  • PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus.

  • Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening…

  • Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers.

  • Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology.

  • Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result.

  • Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack.

  • Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English.

Nice to have

  • Strong experience working with experimentalists.

  • Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either.

  • Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs).

  • Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks.

  • Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Orakl Oncology is committed to diversity and equal opportunity. All qualified applications will be considered.

description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a senior Systems Engineer to join our Program & Systems Engineering department and contribute to the development of our photonic quantum computing systems, including strategic programs such as QBI Phase B and PROQCIMA+.

As our first dedicated Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the technical consistency of our complex systems, bringing together photonics, electronics, mechanics, cryogenics and software. You will own the system technical baseline, working with domain experts who contribute to subsystem expertise and detailed technical inputs.

Working closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams and reporting to the CTO, you will operate as a peer of the Program Manager, with a dotted-line relationship for program priorities. You will own the definition and implementation of systems engineering practices, from requirements definition and system architecture to integration, verification and validation. You will provide technical recommendations and escalate unresolved trade-offs to the CTO, while Program and Project Managers own priorities, budgets and delivery planning.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

  • System architecture & requirements: Define and maintain system-level requirements, translate them into subsystem specifications, and ensure consistency and traceability throughout development. Own the system architecture and controlled technical baseline, consolidating contributions from domain experts and requirements from customer projects in coordination with the relevant Project Manager. 
  • Interface management: Coordinate technical interfaces between subsystems, identify dependencies, and ensure compatibility across engineering disciplines. Establish Interface Control Documents (ICDs), with a named technical owner on each side of each interface. 
  • Verification & validation: Define system-level V&V strategies, acceptance criteria to ensure system performance and compliance with requirements. Own the V&V plan and organize requirements and architecture, design, and integration-readiness reviews, with clear readiness criteria and traceability between requirements and verification evidence. 
  • Technical coordination & risk management: Assess design trade-offs and support engineering teams in resolving complex integration challenges. Take ownership of technical risks in the shared risk register and propose mitigation actions. Work with Program and Project Managers to assess cost and schedule implications, escalating unresolved disagreements to the CTO. 
  • Change control: Assess the technical impact of proposed changes to requirements, architecture, interfaces and supplier specifications or parts. Support the change-control process chaired by the Program Manager, with cost and schedule assessments provided by the Project Manager, and maintain the approved technical baseline. 
  • Roadmap contributions: Provide technical inputs to the integrated multi-year roadmap, including technical dependencies, constraints affecting the critical path and readiness criteria for technical gates. Support Program and Project Managers in aligning technical milestones with resources and budgets. 
  • Systems engineering processes: Establish and continuously improve pragmatic engineering methodologies, documentation and tools adapted to a fast-growing R&D environment. Define roles, responsibilities and processes before selecting tools. Prioritize requirements and traceability, interface control, change control, technical reviews and V&V; pilot lightweight processes on one project, obtain CTO approval and support wider adoption. 
  • Engineering tools: Own requirements and traceability tools, define needs and lead evaluations and pilots for CTO approval. Build on the existing environment and introduce dedicated requirements management or model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools only when justified by system complexity or practical limitations.

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or equivalent qualification in systems engineering, physics, electronics, photonics, mechatronics or related fields. 
  • Solid experience (+8 years) in systems engineering, system architecture, or multidisciplinary system integration, ideally involving complex hardware and software systems. Experience taking technical responsibility for large, complex systems and establishing a controlled requirements and architecture baseline is particularly relevant. 
  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, interface management, technical risk assessment and verification & validation methodologies, including requirements traceability, ICDs and technical change-impact assessment. 
  • Ability to integrate domain experts’ contributions into a coherent system architecture and work effectively alongside Program and Project Managers. 
  • Ability to structure systems engineering practices while remaining pragmatic and hands-on in an evolving R&D environment. 
  • Experience introducing systems engineering processes or tools in a growing organization. Ability to define process needs first and scale tools accordingly; familiarity with requirements management and MBSE approaches is an advantage. 
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to challenge technical decisions. Ability to explain technical trade-offs, make clear recommendations, and escalate unresolved issues constructively. 
  • Professional proficiency in English. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
